name: TimeDesk
description: A clean, minimal web app that provides a Clock, Timer, and Stopwatch, with a launcher page and left side panel that opens each tool in a separate browser tab.
whatItDoes: Provides a focused browser-based Clock, Timer, and Stopwatch experience.
features: Clock with a large centered 24-hour display
Timer with minutes input plus Start and Reset
Stopwatch with Start, Stop, and Reset
aiRole: AI-assisted iteration focused on structuring the interface, refining code, and debugging workflow.
impact: Successful project — live demo deployed on Netlify.

readmeSections.heading: Overview
readmeSections.text: A clean, minimal web app that provides a Clock, Timer, and Stopwatch. Includes a launcher page with a left side panel that opens each tool in a separate browser tab, plus individual pages for each tool. Ready for GitHub Pages.

readmeSections.heading: Features
items: Launcher with minimize / maximize behavior
Clock page with large bold 24-hour display, centered
Timer page accepts minutes, large centered display, Start and Reset
Stopwatch page with Start Stop Reset and large centered display
Each tool opens in its own browser tab from the launcher
Dark theme and easy font customization

readmeSections.heading: Run locally
items: Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/mohammedzaid00100/repo-name.git
cd repo-name

screenshots.alt: Daily Routine Scheduler project notes and documentation.

readmeSections.heading: Overview
readmeSections.text: A minimal, robust web app to add tasks, schedule reminders (up to 7 days ahead), and view a persistent monthly dashboard.

readmeSections.heading: Quick start
items: Copy files into a new project folder.
Create .env from env.example and set values.
Install dependencies with npm install.
Seed sample data (optional) with npm run seed.
Start backend with npm run dev:server.
Start frontend with npm run dev:client.

readmeSections.heading: Tech stack
items: Frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Chart.js
Backend: Node.js + Express
Database: MongoDB (Mongoose)

readmeSections.heading: Overview
readmeSections.text: PlotGraphify is an experimental Progressive Web Application built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Its goal was to create a simple, offline-first tool that allows users to generate line graphs from custom data and manage them locally on their device.

readmeSections.heading: Current status
readmeSections.text: This project is incomplete and is no longer under active development.

readmeSections.heading: Known issues
items: Significant bugs and glitches
Several unfinished or partially implemented features
Inconsistent UI/UX
Front-end codebase needs better organization and refactoring
Responsiveness and overall user experience need improvement
Performance optimization is incomplete
Some interactions and animations are rough or unreliable
The project is not production-ready

readmeSections.heading: Tech stack
items: HTML5
CSS3
Vanilla JavaScript

readmeSections.heading: Why it remains public
readmeSections.text: The project represents an experiment and a learning record around web development, debugging, project planning, and the challenges of building a complete application from scratch.
